ADVANCEN® for ISOFIX

Product code：
productCode2223323

Contact us about this product
Add to My List
View this product's catalog

The AiryString® tapeless zipper is designed for elements to be sewn directly onto fabric by a special machine. By eliminating the zipper tapes, the AiryString® zipper offers more flexibility and weight reduction of the final product, in turn allowing for more design possibilities.
Compared to standard zippers, the AiryString® tapeless zipper produces less greenhouse gas emissions during production.
YKK will work together with customers to incorporate this unique and revolutionary zipper into their products as all parts for the zipper are supplied by YKK and require a special sewing machine.

Item Variations

Available in sizes: #5 in closed-end and open-end chain type.

 	Classification
  Close      	       Open      	     Two-way   	Chain
Size/ Chain Type	8CFT14	OK	-	-	OK
8CFT15	OK	-	-	OK
10CFT14	-	-	-	OK
10CFT15	-	-	-	OK
Color Variations

AiryString® #5 with closed-end and open-end:




- Elements color options: Based on YKK Global Color Card, metallic (MP, MG, MB, MR, MJ, SIL4)and DTM.
- Core cord color options: Black and White




The color combination is elements color x core cord color.




Please contact your local YKK sales representative for more details.

methodology.browser: Playwright Chromium, headless; fresh context per language/viewport; deviceScaleFactor=1; no throttling or mobile user-agent emulation
methodology.timing: Absolute offsets from completion of page.goto(waitUntil=load); actualObservationMs recorded before screenshot. Full-page PNG at each point; only blank captures retained in git.
methodology.count: All main descendants with nonzero box and checkVisibility(opacity/CSS), top at or below breadcrumb bottom, excluding breadcrumb descendants/ancestors and script/style/link. Includes containers and offscreen document content; no scrolling performed.
methodology.contentVisible: At least one counted element with direct nonempty text or IMG/VIDEO/CANVAS/SVG.
methodology.errors: Cumulative since navigation at each sample; first 5 console/page errors and first 10 HTTP >=400 or requestfailed events. Null status means no HTTP failure status available; transport error included.
methodology.interpretation: Pass means recording completed only. English SP content appeared between sampled +3 and +10 seconds; exact onset and cause not measured. No product verdict.
